'''Maximum Security Pod J-P7''' was a facility in the [[Special Restraint Cells]] section of the [[Maximum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], [[Havoc Squad]] attempted to rendezvous with [[Dagger Wing]] at Pod J-P7.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maximum Security Pod J-P7 is a class-restricted area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Trooper class mission "Slicing the Net" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
